event: A creak and thud sound occurs, and its location needs to be determined relative to a hypothetical robot.

sounding_object.description: The man, specifically his left foot in a dark sneaker (black or dark gray with white laces and sole), making a creak and thud sound as it contacts the dark brown wooden floor while he is putting on the shoe.

reference_object.object_name: Light-gray armchair further from wall painting
reference_object.description: A light-gray upholstered armchair with wooden legs and a blue patterned pillow on it. It is located to the left (from the initial camera perspective) of the white recessed fireplace, near a white interior door. This is the armchair further from the colorful circular wall painting seen near the arched window.

facing_object.description: A white recessed fireplace with a dark interior. It has a mantelpiece above it, decorated with small orange carrot-shaped items and a small doll. A large potted plant (aloe vera or similar) is to its left.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the light-gray armchair further from the wall painting and facing the white recessed fireplace, when the creak and thud sound comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the sounding object: front-left, front-right, back-left, or back-right? The directions refer to the quadrants of a Cartesian plane (if you are standing at the origin and facing along the positive y-axis). Consider the center point location of the object as the its location.
